title: Hypercar Grand Prix
description: Race hypercars like the Bugatti Tourbillon on a large track with full dashboard gauges, tire puncture mechanics, and engine temperature management.
prompt: mario kart clone, but with hypercars on massive maps where you can go full speed. example cars: bugatti tourbillon, bugatti chiron, etc. show all the gauges such as speed, rpm, oil press/temp, radiator temp, tyre pressures (have a button to re-inflate - make a few of the items you pick up and drop puncture types etc. have a button to spray engine with water if it gets too hot etc
